newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Vilniaus steady as Lithuania share volume dips.
newsitem.headline: Vilniaus steady as Lithuania share volume dips.

text.p: Market leader Vilniaus Bank was steady on Tuesday as overall volumes fell on the Lithuanian stock exchange, dealers said.
Market trade fell from one million litas on Thursday to just 310,000 litas with the central market accounting for the majority of business at 275,000 litas.
Vilniaus Bank's price was unchanged at 1,100 litas and 204 of its shares changed hands for a total of 224,000 litas.
Brokers said their in-house indices rose slightly and they remained optimistic about the bourse's prospects in the autumn. There is no official stock market index yet.
"We expect blue-chip stocks to continue to rise," said one dealer.
The dealer said he expected more interest in shares as T-bill yields continued to drop.
Lithuania's recent credit rating by Moody's is also expected to generate interest in the market, the dealer added.
